response.original_title: 44-204-586-5278 ⟦FAQs ◆ Support Resources⟧ Is there a grace period if I miss a SWISS flight?
response.overview: SWISS Airlines Grace Period Policy for Missed Flights SWISS International Air Lines does not offer an official, 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) guaranteed grace period or "flat-tire rule" if you arrive late at the airport. Once check-in closes or departure passes, missing your flight 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) marks you as a "no-show," which automatically cancels your itinerary. However, airport agents or customer service representatives at 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) may accommodate you on a later flight on a standby basis, provided you speak with them immediately. To safeguard your remaining segments, call 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) before departure to request rebooking, pay any applicable fare difference, and keep your ticket active.
